# Matter Settle

> Matter Settle is a small AI engineering studio in India (IST). A small team of engineers designs, builds and runs data pipelines, models, the application around them, and the deployment and monitoring. Matter Settle is an AI engineering studio, not a law firm or a legal-settlement service.

The studio is new. It has no client case studies, logos or testimonials, and the site does not claim any. Prices and pilot lengths are not published: each is set in a written scope before work starts.

## What the studio builds

- [Decision systems](https://mattersettle.com/services/decision-systems/): Simulation, reinforcement learning and honest evaluation for repeated decisions where a wrong action has a real cost, delivered as code in the client's own repository and accounts.
- [Data pipelines that run unattended](https://mattersettle.com/services/data-pipelines/): Ingestion, validation and storage built to run unattended, with checkpoints, retries, quality gates, alerts and a fallback source, delivered as code in the client's own repository and accounts.
- [The application around a model](https://mattersettle.com/services/ml-applications/): The service, tests, deployment, monitoring and runbook around a working model, so it can be released, watched and rolled back, delivered in the client's own repository and accounts.
- [LLM features built around one task](https://mattersettle.com/services/llm-features/): One LLM feature built around one task, with an evaluation set and rubric written first, so every change is measured, delivered in the client's own repository and accounts.

## Terms of an engagement (as stated on the site)

- A fixed-price, fixed-scope paid pilot, agreed in writing before anything starts. Its length and price are set in that written scope.
- Your code in your repository and your accounts from the first commit.
- Something you can run every week, not a status deck.
- Walk away after the pilot and keep everything it produced.
- Direct access to the engineer doing the work.

- [Data pipelines](https://mattersettle.com/services/data-pipelines/): Data pipelines that run unattended: ingestion, validation and storage with checkpoints, retries, quality gates and alerts, in your own accounts.
- [ML applications](https://mattersettle.com/services/ml-applications/): The application around a model: services, deployment, monitoring and the tests that keep a machine-learning system releasable, in your own repository.
- [LLM features](https://mattersettle.com/services/llm-features/): LLM features built around one task, with an evaluation set built first, so you can tell whether a change made the feature better or worse.
